slides.name: hook
slides.head:
दिवाली पे उसका मैसेज
आएगा या नहीं?
slides.sub: और तुम फ़ोन फिर से देख रहे हो।

slides.name: card
slides.title: Four of Cups
slides.sub: The card of staring at what isn't there.

slides.name: cloud
slides.label: LOOK CLOSER
slides.head: A hand from the cloud offers him a cup.
slides.sub:
He doesn't see it. His eyes are on
the three cups that didn't fill him.

slides.name: message
slides.quote: जो नहीं आया, उसे देखते-देखते, जो आया है वो मत खो देना।
slides.trans: Don't lose what is being offered while you watch for what never came.
